sm-agent.description: Scrum Master — coordinates multi-agent SDLC pipeline (BA→SA→DEV→QA→DevOps)

ba-agent.description: Business Analyst — reads Jira tickets, creates BRD/FSD documents

ta-agent.description: Technical Architect — enriches FSD with API contracts, integration specs, pseudocode

sa-agent.description: Solution Architect — reads BRD/FSD, analyzes codebase, creates TDD

dev-agent.description: Developer — implements code from TDD, creates tests, writes User Guide

qa-agent.description: QA Engineer — creates test plans (STP), test cases (STC), executes manual tests

devops-agent.description: DevOps Engineer — deployment guides, release notes, CI/CD, git release

security-agent.description: Security Expert — OWASP-based security audits with remediation code

ui-agent.description: UI/UX Designer — creates wireframes, mockups, HTML/CSS prototypes
